== English Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck comparison ==
The physical first printing has Pilot and Warrior icons. Decipher's 30 May 2001 erratum gives Lando a permanent weapon icon. The archived Decipher gallery already displays it, as does the physical Reflections III foil. The Players Committee retained one permanent weapon icon in its E-marked Holotable rendition and on its current D-E1 face. The printed game text and statistics agree across these publications.

[https://web.archive.org/web/20010613012725id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgsupplement053001.pdf#page=7 Decipher Glossary Supplement, 30 May 2001, PDF p. 7]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=119 2023 Appendix A, p. 119].
